To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
our MSMT-GAN outperforms the previous state of art on the CUC and COCO datasets by a significant margin.

we present a novel multi-tailed, multi-headed, spatial dynamic memory refinement mechanism for text-to-image synthesis that outperforms the state-of-the-art in terms of both qualitative and quantitative metrics on CUB and COCOL datasets.
we propose a novel image synthesis model, MSMT-GAN, that uses multi-tailed, multi-headed refinement to generate images from text descriptions.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the development of a novel image synthesis framework that is able to synthesize high-quality realistic images from text descriptions, by addressing the shortcomings of existing text-to-image synthesis frameworks.
the development of a novel multi-tailed, multi-headed, spatial dynamic memory refinement mechanism that allows us to synthesize high-quality, realistic, images from text-descriptors.
developing new techniques to generate high-resolution images from text-descriptors.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
our proposed MSMT-GAN model is a novel, multi-tailed, multi-headed, spatial dynamic memory refinement text-to-image synthesis model that outperforms the previous state of art.

our method is the first to introduce a novel multi-tailed word-level initial generation stage that separates image attributes at a n-gram level, a novel spatial dynamic memory mechanism for image refinement and an iterative multi-headed refinement mechanism to make it possible to refine different image aspects in a precise manner.
our proposed MSMT-GAN method performs favourably against state-of-the-art text to image generation methods on two standard datasets, CUB and COCOCOCO.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we propose a novel multi-tailed, multi-headed spatial dynamic memory image generation framework that can be used for text-to-image synthesis tasks.
, our MSMT-GAN can be considered a refinement of the GAN framework, where the refinement is done by a novel Spatial Dynamic Memory module.
we propose to refine images in an iterative multi-headed manner.
The main takeaway from our work is that
we can improve the quality of the initial image by separating image attributes at a finer granularity and by generating refinement features at a finer granularity.

by using an initial image generation mechanism to separate image attributes from text at a word-level, we enable the subsequent refinement stages to be more precise and accurate in their image generation.
by explicitly generating image features for each n-gram, and then refining them in a multi-headed manner, we can improve the quality of text-to-image generation.
